available.quote: Registration of a professional engineer through comity or reciprocal registration. – Notwithstanding the requirements of the foregoing subsection of this section, the board may issue a license to an applicant who holds a valid license or other authorization to practice engineering from another state

requirements.value: Applicant must satisfy general requirements of subsection (a), satisfy additional requirements specified by board rule, and either: (1) hold a license from another jurisdiction with equivalent standards and credentials, which may include an NCEES council record; or (2) hold a valid NCEES council record indicating the applicant meets this article's requirements.
requirements.quote: Holds a license or other authorization to engage in the practice of engineering issued by a proper authority of any jurisdiction, based on requirements that do not conflict with the provisions of this article and possesses credentials that are, in the judgment of the board, of a standard equivalent to or not lower than that specified in the applicable licensure act and rules in effect in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Perpetrating fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain or renew a certificate of registration or authorization.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Perpetrated any fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain or renew a certificate of registration or certificate of authorization

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being negligent, incompetent, or committing an act of misconduct in the practice of engineering.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been negligent, incompetent or committed an act of misconduct in the practice of engineering

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea of nolo contendere to a felony or crime involving dishonesty or directly related to engineering practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of or has entered a plea of nolo contendere to any crime under the laws of the United States or any state or territory thereof, which is a felony whether related to practice or not; and conviction of or entry of a plea of nolo contendere to any crime, whether a felony, misdemeanor or otherwise, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or which is directly related to the practice of engineering

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with any provisions of the article or rules promulgated under it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with any of the provisions of this article or any of the rules promulgated under it

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by another state, territory, federal government, or other governmental agency for substantially equivalent grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been disciplined by another state, territory, the District of Columbia, foreign country, the United States government or any other governmental agency, if at least one of the grounds for discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those grounds for discipline contained in this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within thirty days to provide information requested by the board as result of a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed within thirty days to provide information requested by the board as a result of a formal or informal complaint to the board which would indicate a violation of this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or signing false statements, certificates, or affidavits to induce payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made false statements or signed false statements, certificates or affidavits to induce payment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of the article or rules promulgated thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating terms of probation imposed by the board, or using a seal or practicing engineering while the license is suspended, revoked, nonrenewed, or inactive.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any terms of probation imposed by the board or using a seal or practicing engineering while the professional engineer's license is suspended, revoked, nonrenewed or inactive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or affixing the professional engineer's seal to documents not prepared or completely checked by the professional engineer or under their direct supervision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signed or affixed the professional engineer's seal or permitted the professional engineer's seal or signature to be affixed to any specifications, reports, drawings, plans, design information, construction documents or calculations or revisions which have not been prepared or completely checked by the professional engineer or under the professional engineer's direct supervision or control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false testimony or information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being habitually intoxicated or addicted to or by the use of drugs or alcohol.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person or firm is authorized to practice or offer to practice engineering in this state until the person or firm has been issued a certificate of authorization by the board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of engineering" means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems; planning the use of land and water; teaching of advanced engineering subjects, engineering surveys and studies; and the review of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with drawings and specifications any of which embraces such services or work, either public or private, in connection with any utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work systems, projects and industrial or consumer products or equipment of a mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic or thermal nature, insofar as they involve safeguarding life, health or property

value: Practice of any other legally recognized profession
Temporary permits for nonresident engineers legally qualified in their own state or country for a specific job
Employees or subordinates doing work that does not include final engineering designs or decisions, done under direct supervision of a registered professional engineer
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This article may not be construed to prevent the practice by: (a) Other professions. -- The practice of any other legally recognized profession; (b) Temporary permits. -- The practice or offer to practice engineering by a person not a resident of or having no established place of business in this state, provided the person is legally qualified by registration to practice engineering; (c) Employees and subordinates. -- The work of an employee or a subordinate of a person holding a certificate of registration

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The board may promulgate and shall adopt "rules of professional responsibility for professional engineers". These rules are binding to any person registered with the board under the provisions of this article.

retired_status_license_available.quote: Professional engineer-retired. – A registrant may apply for retired status upon certification that he or she is no longer practicing or offering to practice engineering in this state for remuneration.
